notes: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of October 30, 2022, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.
